name: Karamemo Ensemble
original_name: カラメモ アンサンブル
source:
A game continuing the karaoke theme with a group of great boys, but this time it's needed to type your story when there is window for input.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
本作延续了与一群优秀男生唱卡拉OK的主题，不过这一次，每当出现输入窗口时，玩家都需要亲手键入自己的故事。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-may-2004-carnival.html]vndbreview[/url]]
